In this course you learn the math inside games: vectors and matrices,
2D and 3D coordinates, moving, turning and scaling objects, angles
(trigonometry), probability and random numbers, and logic.
You see it in a game, you try it in a small simulator, then you write it.

## Lessons

New lessons appear here every week.

::: {#lessons}
:::

Take-home tasks. Each homework opens with its week.
